source.sql: SELECT PLANT_ID, PLANT_NAME, PLANT_TYPE, REGION_LABEL FROM VEDANTA_POC.DIM_PLANT WHERE PLANT_ID <> 'ALL_PLANTS'
SELECT POSTING_MONTH AS MONTH, PLANT_ID, KPI_CODE, KPI_VALUE, KPI_UOM, SCENARIO_LABEL AS SCENARIO FROM VEDANTA_POC.INVENTORY_KPI_MONTHLY ORDER BY POSTING_MONTH, PLANT_ID, KPI_CODE, SCENARIO_LABEL

SELECT IC.PLANT_ID, DM.MATERIAL_GROUP, IC.CRITICALITY, IC.MOVEMENT_CLASS, IC.INVENTORY_STATUS, IC.ABC_CLASS, COUNT(*) AS MATERIALS, SUM(IC.AVAILABLE_QTY) AS AVAILABLE_QTY, SUM(IC.INVENTORY_VALUE_INR) AS VALUE_INR FROM VEDANTA_POC.INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION IC JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_MATERIAL DM ON DM.MATERIAL_ID = IC.MATERIAL_ID WHERE DM.MATERIAL_TYPE IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') AND IC.PLANT_ID <> 'ALL_PLANTS' GROUP BY IC.PLANT_ID, DM.MATERIAL_GROUP, IC.CRITICALITY, IC.MOVEMENT_CLASS, IC.INVENTORY_STATUS, IC.ABC_CLASS

SELECT IC.MATERIAL_ID, IC.PLANT_ID, DM.MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, DM.MATERIAL_GROUP, DM.MATERIAL_TYPE, IC.CRITICALITY, IC.ABC_CLASS, IC.XYZ_CLASS, IC.MOVEMENT_CLASS, IC.INVENTORY_STATUS, SUM(IC.AVAILABLE_QTY) AS AVAILABLE_QTY, SUM(IC.INVENTORY_VALUE_INR) AS VALUE_INR, MAX(IC.DAYS_ON_HAND) AS DAYS_ON_HAND, MAX(IC.DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CONSUMPTION) AS DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CONSUMPTION, MAX(IC.SAFETY_STOCK_QTY) AS SAFETY_STOCK_QTY, MAX(IC.REORDER_POINT_QTY) AS REORDER_POINT_QTY, MAX(IC.MAX_STOCK_QTY) AS MAX_STOCK_QTY, MAX(IC.TRAILING_12M_DEMAND_QTY) AS TRAILING_12M_DEMAND_QTY FROM VEDANTA_POC.INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION IC JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_MATERIAL DM ON DM.MATERIAL_ID = IC.MATERIAL_ID WHERE DM.MATERIAL_TYPE IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') AND IC.PLANT_ID <> 'ALL_PLANTS' GROUP BY IC.MATERIAL_ID, IC.PLANT_ID, DM.MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION, DM.MATERIAL_GROUP, DM.MATERIAL_TYPE, IC.CRITICALITY, IC.ABC_CLASS, IC.XYZ_CLASS, IC.MOVEMENT_CLASS, IC.INVENTORY_STATUS

SELECT RECOMMENDATION_ID, MATERIAL_ID, PLANT_ID, PRIORITY, RECOMMENDED_PR_DATE, RECOMMENDED_QTY, ESTIMATED_VALUE_INR, AVAILABLE_QTY, OPEN_PR_QTY, OPEN_PO_QTY, SAFETY_STOCK_QTY, REORDER_POINT_QTY, RECOMMENDATION_REASON AS REASON, SHUTDOWN_ID FROM VEDANTA_POC.REORDER_RECOMMENDATION WHERE PLANT_ID <> 'ALL_PLANTS'

SELECT CALENDAR_MONTH AS MONTH, PLANT_ID, MATERIAL_GROUP, MATERIAL_TYPE, SHUTDOWN_DRIVEN, PLAN_VALUE_INR, ACTUAL_PO_VALUE_INR, ACTUAL_GR_VALUE_INR, VARIANCE_INR, VARIANCE_PCT FROM VEDANTA_POC.BUSINESS_PLAN_VS_ACTUAL WHERE PLANT_ID <> 'ALL_PLANTS'
